extracted text: The paper studies AA2219 aluminum alloy in T87 temper condition. The T87 temper involves solution treatment at 807 K (534°C) for 1 hour, followed by 7% stretching and aging at 436 K (163°C) for 24 hours. The base metal (BM) and welded (AW and RW) specimens were studied. The microhardness values for the base metal were measured to be around 128 Hv.
